name: What is the best type of garage flooring for a home workshop or remodel?

mainEntity.name: What is the best type of garage flooring for a home workshop or remodel?

acceptedAnswer.text: The best garage flooring depends on how you use the space and your budget. Epoxy and polyaspartic coatings provide a durable, seamless surface that resists chemicals, vehicle fluids, and heavy foot traffic. Interlocking rigid tiles or heavy-duty rubber tiles allow faster installation and hide cracked concrete without extensive surface repair, but moisture can get trapped underneath. If your garage doubles as a finished workshop or living extension, coated concrete is often preferred because it sweeps clean easily and seals out moisture from below. When planning your garage remodel, evaluating whether the slab has active moisture issues or uneven settling helps decide between a liquid coating and a floating tile system.
acceptedAnswer.description: Coated concrete systems like epoxy resist chemicals and sweep clean easily, while interlocking tiles install faster but can trap moisture underneath.
